notes: Measured with drafts/content/tools/loot-per-run-sim.test.ts.keep: the smart bot, typical skill, 200 seeds (1-200), tier 1 stats {100 health, 10 power, 0 guard} on belt 1 and tier 3 stats {332.79, 45.85, 33.53} on belt 3, on main's content. Each number is how many of that enemy appear in the rooms one run actually plays (Dough Blob splits counted). Expected drops per run = sum(count x chance). check-loot-b3.py reads this file. Each belt's dataSha256 is a SHA-256 of every room of that belt's floor set (White Dojo for belt 1, Ember Kitchens for belt 3) and the enemies they use, on main a04f3f8 (re-measured on a04f3f8: belt 1 counts identical to before, belt 3 counts moved by under 1.5 percent, for example spark-sprite 54.375 to 53.855, most likely because sim code changed in #439; I did not check which change). check-loot-b3.py recomputes both and fails with a 're-run the sim' message if either changes.
